propositions: 91 ADR files exist with only 69 distinct numbers; 17 numbers are duplicated across 22 files, creating collision risk and reference ambiguity.

Collisions stem from stale-base merges (16 of 22) and race conditions (6 of 22); a pre-merge marker-file mechanism in docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN creates add/add conflicts that prevent Rebase-If-Necessary from auto-resolving same-number ADRs.

22 duplicate-numbered ADRs must be renumbered to 0070-0091 in ascending landing-date order, with earliest-landed ADRs retaining their original numbers; mapping and per-reference resolution recorded in RENUMBERING.md.
All slug-bearing ADR cross-references in docs/ and src/ that name moved ADRs must be rewritten to their final 0070-0091 numbers; referential integrity enforced via check_adr_numbers.py exit code.

CI must assert bijection between ADRs and marker files, unique marker content, and referential integrity of all adr/NNNN-slug markdown links; gen_adr_index.py must generate a grouped index in docs/adr/README.md.
